verdict.rationale: Elicit lets users export their Library as .ris and export tables (screening/data extraction) as CSV, Excel, RIS, or BIB—all open formats—supporting the 'leave' theme (elicit-docs-5, elicit-docs-19, elicit-docs-25). However, table export is gated to Pro/Scale/Enterprise plans, and there's no evidence of exporting full account data (Research Agent session history, skills, projects, alerts) in bulk or via API for a complete 'take everything and leave' experience. Missing for 10: full-account/session export, evidence of open-format export for non-review workflows, and confirmation that API access (elicit-docs-6) supports full data extraction.
